title: Progress under PM JANMAN for development of PVTGs
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Tribal Affairs

Progress under PM JANMAN for development of PVTGs

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
12 AUG 2026 12:42PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed Rajya Sabha that
Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN) aims to provide basic facilities to improve their socio-economic conditions such as safe housing, clean drinking water and improved access to education, health and nutrition, road and telecom connectivity, electrification of unelectrified households and sustainable livelihood opportunities for the development of 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) communities residing in 18 States including Gujarat and one Union Territory. These objectives are being met through 11 interventions implemented by 9-line Ministries. The details of the benefits given under PM JANMAN, as on 30.06.2026, Ministry-wise & State-wise, are given at
Annexure I
.
Ministry of Tribal Affairs through the State Governments/UT Administration/departments has undertaken habitation level data collection exercise through PM Gati Shakti mobile application to estimate PVTG population figures and infrastructure gaps in order to cover PVTG population residing in villages & habitations covered under PM JANMAN. Based on the data captured, State/UT- wise, PVTG villages, habitations and population is tabulated at
Annexure II
. The actual number beneficiaries to be covered under the abhiyan is subjected to eligibility criteria of specific guidelines of concerned interventions as per norms approved.
